# Udyog Growth

> Udyog Growth (udyoggrowth.com) is an Indian consultancy for government subsidies
> (PMFME 35% subsidy, PMKSY, PLI, PMEGP, CGTMSE), GST notice replies and litigation
> (DRC-01/DRC-06, ASMT-10, ITC mismatch, audits, appeals), GeM registration,
> government tender bidding, and departmental liaisoning.

## Services
- PMFME subsidy consultancy: 35% credit-linked subsidy up to Rs 10 lakh, DPR preparation, ODOP alignment, SHG/FPO group projects
- MoFPI schemes: PMKSY, PLI, Mega Food Parks, Cold Chain, Agro Processing Clusters
- MSME schemes: Udyam Registration, PMEGP, CGTMSE credit guarantee, ZED Certification, MSE-CDP
- GST notices: DRC-01 show cause notice reply in DRC-06, ASMT-10, ITC mismatch (GSTR-2B vs 3B), personal hearings
- GST audits/assessments/appeals: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida; high-value Bihar GST matters; Tribunal & High Court appeals; DGGI matters
- GeM: seller registration (3-5 days), catalogue upload, vendor assessment, OEM panel, bid participation
- Tenders: bid preparation, consortium/JV, Bihar govt tenders (Panchayati Raj, IT, Urban Housing)

## Why clients choose Udyog Growth
On-ground departmental presence and long-standing professional working relationships
in Delhi, NCR and Bihar; physical representation at hearings and follow-ups.
